headline: Argentina's Country Risk Drops Below 1,000 Points as Bonds and Stocks Rally
summary: Argentina's country risk indicator compiled by JP Morgan dropped 121 units to fall below 1,000 points, while local equities and ADRs surged in Wall Street trading.
why: Sovereign risk spreads measure investor perception of default risk and heavily influence government borrowing costs and capital market access.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Falling sovereign risk spreads reflect improved investor confidence in Argentine assets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Positive market sentiment and international asset demand drove sovereign bond prices up and risk spreads below the 1,000-point threshold.
